entities.summary: Hans Ree is a Dutch chess grandmaster and writer. He is a chess columnist for NRC Handelsblad, and contributes to the chess magazines New In Chess and ChessCafe.com. His earlier publications include Een blinde reus, Rode dagen en zwarte dagen and Schaakstukjes.
